description: Creates a calendar of the teams a name picks out, such as "phoenix suns", and answers with its links. Its feed is the .ics address a calendar app subscribes to, and it stays up to date as games are scheduled or moved. A name such as "giants" picks out more than one team, so check with find_teams when a name could. Fails when it names none.
name: create_named_calendar

subscribe.description: The whole addresses a person subscribes with, one for each calendar app, and what an assistant tells them.

appleUrl.description: The one-click link for Apple Calendar, on a Mac, iPhone or iPad: the feed's webcal address.

directions.description: What each link is for and why clicking one is safe, for an assistant to pass on to the person.

feedUrl.description: The feed's whole https address, for any other calendar app's "subscribe by URL".

googleUrl.description: The one-click link for Google Calendar. It opens Google Calendar with the feed ready to add, and the person confirms there. The only way into Google Calendar: Google offers an app no way to subscribe someone to a feed.

manageUrl.description: The page where the person changes the calendar's teams and settings later.

outlookUrl.description: The one-click link for Outlook on the web.

title: Create a calendar from a team name
